summary: Dallas-based and mostly point-to-point, with no single hub. All flights now have assigned seats.
checkin: Check-in, and digital bag check, opens 24 hours before departure. Basic fares get a seat assigned at check-in; higher fares can pick seats earlier.
baggage: Carry-on and personal item are free. US mainland checked bags (booked on or after April 9, 2026): 1st $45, 2nd $55, up to 50 lb and 62 in. Choice Extra fares include 2 free bags.
tips: Rapid Rewards credit cardmembers get the 1st bag free if their Rapid Rewards number is on the booking.
A-List Preferred members and active-duty military check 2 bags free.
Hawaii interisland bags are cheaper: $30 for the 1st and $40 for the 2nd.
